ops.en: VA-YIZKOR ELOHIM — 'and God REMEMBERED': ZAKHAR, the remember-verb, FIRST TOKEN of 42 in the Torah, born with Noach AND every living thing as its object — the animals are remembered by name-class alongside the man. The Name returns to the page (Elohim x2, the span's only divine-name tokens — gen_18 had none) but SPEECH does not: the first divine interior event since gen_15's regret-and-grief, and …

VA-YAAVER — 'and He PASSED a wind/spirit over the earth': AVAR, the pass-over verb, FIRST TOKEN of 130 (career: Abram crossing the land 12:6, the covenant-pieces passing 15:17) — and its first object is RUACH ('wind/spirit', token 7): 1:2's hovering word set MOVING over the flood [lexically real creation-mirror: ruach + over; hover -> pass].

VA-YASHOKU — 'and the waters SUBSIDED': a TWO-token Torah verb; its only other token is Num 17:20 — God subsiding the camp's murmurings: both tokens calm an uprising [letter fact, held; Onkelos renders the REST-verb (ve-nachu) — handing the waters, three verses early, the root the Hebrew saves for the ark; dual-track, flagged].

A PHYSICAL PROPERTY DERIVED FROM THE VERB THAT ENDS IT [claim G19-12]. Our 8:1 says the waters וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ (va-yashoku, 'abated'), and the same verb describes a king's wrath being ASSUAGED - which is to say COOLED. By verbal analogy Rav Chisda concludes the flood waters were scalding: 'they sinned with boiling passion and were punished with boiling water'. The world-state's temperature is inferre…

THE UNIT'S OWN TOPOGRAPHY TYPED BY ATTRIBUTE [claim G19-16]. The remembering is read as covering the whole ark's manifest, and the flood's two halves are typed by the geography each used: judgment came through the DEPTHS, broken open at 7:11; kindness through the MOUNTAINS, on which the ark came to rest. [folded shape: kept record]

VA-YISAKHRU — 'and they were STOPPED UP' (niphal, agentless, TIR-032): 7:11's double breach shut in ONE agentless verb — and the verb is a TORAH HAPAX (sakhar: this token and no other), NOT 7:16's door-verb sagar ('shut'): the door and the sky get different shut-words [letter fact]. The mirror is NEAR-verbatim: the same nouns in order — fountains of the deep, windows of the heavens — but 7:11's KO…

VA-YIKKALE — 'and the rain was RESTRAINED' (niphal, agentless, TIR-032): KALA, the restrain-verb, FIRST TOKEN of 4 — career token 3 is Exod 36:6: RESTRAINING the Tabernacle donations (rain from heaven, generosity in the camp — the verb's two great stoppages). GESHEM ('rain-shower') token 2 of 3: began 7:12, restrained here, given back as blessing at Lev 26:4.

VA-YASHUVU — 'and the waters RETURNED': SHUV, the return-verb, tokens 3-7 all in this span — and its tokens 1-2 are 3:19's sentence ('until you RETURN to the ground... to dust you shall RETURN'): the verb that debuted as the death-sentence does its first narrative work sending the flood home [letter fact].

HALOKH VA-SHOV — 'going and returning', the infinitive pair: the walk-verb that carried the ark (7:18) now paces the retreat. And the 150-phrase ('fifty and a hundred days') — token 2 OF 2 in the Torah: 7:24's bracket CLOSED, same digits, same small-first order. MI-QETZEH ('at the end of') — the qetzeh end-word's first token, opening the span's countdown grammar.

VA-YACHSERU — 'and the waters DIMINISHED': CHASAR, the lack-verb, FIRST TOKEN of 7 (tokens 1-2 both in-span); career token 3 = 18:28 — 'perhaps the fifty righteous shall LACK five': the diminish-verb's next job is Abraham's mercy-arithmetic over Sodom.

VA-TANACH — 'and the ark RESTED': NUACH, the rest-verb, FIRST TOKEN of 13 in the Torah (career: God RESTS on the seventh day, Exod 20:11; 'My presence will go and I will give you REST,' Exod 33:14) — landing on the consonants of NOACH's own name. His naming-verse (5:29) derived the name from the COMFORT-verb (nacham, 'this one will comfort us'): the letter here plays the name's SOUND, not its stat…

The calendar returns: month SEVEN, day SEVENTEEN — five months to the day from 7:11's month-2-day-17 [letter arithmetic, both dates on the page]. A date-ladder rung held as FACT, not anchor: the span's one year-bearing date (8:13) takes the t0 register (decision recorded). ARARAT — the place-name a Torah HAPAX.

HALOKH VE-CHASOR — 'going and diminishing': the second infinitive pair (the waters' gait slowed to a wasting). NIRU RASHEI HE-HARIM — 'the tops of the mountains WERE SEEN / appeared' (perfect, held as fact per the morphology convention): the see-verb in the NIPHAL — the SAME verb and stem as 1:9's VE-TERAEH ('and let the dry land BE SEEN') [lexically verified]: day 3's appearance-formula re-runs o…

MI-QETZ — 'at the END of forty days': QETZ token 3 — token 1 = 4:3 (Cain's offering 'at the end of days'), token 2 = 6:13 ('the END of all flesh is come before Me' — the decree's own word): the end-word that announced the killing now counts down to a window opening. The forty re-used: the rain's number becomes the waiting's.

VA-YIFTACH — 'and Noach OPENED': PATACH token 2 — token 1 was 7:11, heaven's windows OPENED with no agent; token 2 is a man's hand on his own window: the same verb passed from sky to hand. CHALON ('window') — 2 Torah tokens (the other: Abimelech's window, 26:8) — ASHER ASAH, 'which he had MADE': the make-verb receipt, gen_16's build resumed mid-story [chalon is a DIFFERENT word from gen_16's tzoha…

VA-YESHALLACH — 'and he SENT the raven' (piel, the release-stem): SHALACH's tokens 1-2 are the EDEN EXPULSION (3:22-23 — humankind sent from the garden); tokens 3-7 are ALL this span's sendings [letter fact]: the verb that exiled now scouts a way home. OREV ('raven') — FIRST TOKEN of 3 (career: the unclean lists, Lev 11:15 / Deut 14:14).

YATZO VA-SHOV — 'going out and returning' (the third infinitive pair: the raven adopts the waters' own gait). AD-YEVOSHET — 'until the DRYING': YAVESH ('be dry') — BOTH its Torah tokens are in this span (here as the raven's horizon; 8:14 as the earth's closing fact), and it is the verb-root of 1:9's YABBASHAH ('dry land') [root-family echo, verified]. The raven never reports; it commutes.

THE DISPATCHED CREATURE ARGUES WITH THE SENDER [claim G19-15]. The raven objects that it is of a species taken only in twos while the species taken in sevens are spared, and asks whether it is its mate that is wanted. It is judged unfit for food and for offering - and the reason given for keeping it alive at all is that ELIJAH will later need ravens to feed him. A creature preserved in this unit b…

The second sending (piel again — the release-stem): YONAH ('dove') — FIRST TOKEN; tokens 1-5 of its Torah 15 are all in this span, and its later career is the poor offerer's birds (Lev 1:14, 5:7) and the new mother's (Lev 12:6): the scout-species becomes the smallest-sacrifice species. ME-ITO — 'from HIM': the dove is sent from his person, where the raven was sent plain [letter fact].

LI-REOT — 'to SEE whether the waters had ABATED': the week's inspection verb handed to a bird as PURPOSE — a question, not a verdict: no oracle inspects, no verdict-word attaches; TESTS stay empty (decision recorded at E). QALAL ('be light / abate') — FIRST TOKEN; token 2 = 8:11 (the knowing), token 3 = 8:21 — LE-QALEL, 'I will not again CURSE the ground': the abate-verb and the never-again-curse …

LO-MATZAH — 'she FOUND no resting-place for the sole of her foot' — held as FACT, not a TESTS-FAIL (decision: the TESTS register carries only the see-verb + verdict-adjective formula; no oracle, no verdict-word here; gen_15's found-grace precedent governs finding-verbs). MATZA's early career is a triptych: no helper FOUND for the man (2:20), Noach FOUND grace (6:8), the dove FINDS nothing (8:9). M…
VA-TASHAV — 'and she RETURNED to him, to the ark': the return-verb again — the dove keeps the span's homing grammar.

VA-YISHLACH YADO — 'and he SENT his HAND': the same send-verb as the birds, but QAL where the sendings are piel [morph split, letter fact]: the fifth send of the span is a rescue reach [Onkelos breaks the run here — 'he stretched out' (oshit); dual-track, flagged].
VA-YIKKACHEHA — 'and he TOOK her': the take-verb's next token (8:20) takes of the clean animals for the altar — the same hand, two takings [letter fact, named].

VA-YAVE — 'and he BROUGHT her in': BO ('come'), the boarding-verb, in its CAUSATIVE stem — what came by itself in gen_17 (the self-loading cargo) is carried in by hand now: the come-verb's arc bends through this verse [letter fact].

VA-YACHEL — 'and he WAITED': the chul-root wait-verb, token 1 of 3 — the FIRST of the two waits, in the FIRST of two different wait-verbs [letter fact; Onkelos levels both to one verb — dual-track, flagged].
'Yet ANOTHER seven days': the dove flies on the week's own rhythm — the seven re-used as patience (7:4's countdown seven, now a waiting seven).
VA-YOSEF SHALLACH — 'and he AGAIN sent': the add-verb (yasaf) rides the send-verb — the inquiry becomes a repeated experiment.

VA-TAVO — 'and she CAME to him' (the come-verb, plain qal — the boarding's verb once more) LE-ET EREV — 'at EVENING-time': EREV ('evening') token 7 — tokens 1-6 are the creation refrain (and-there-was-evening, 1:5-31): the FIRST evening the corpus tells since the week falls on the dove's return [verified]; and ET ('time') itself debuts inside the phrase (token 1 of 36): clock-time enters the corpu…

'Behold: an olive LEAF, freshly plucked, in her mouth.' ALEH ('leaf') — exactly 3 Torah tokens: the fig-leaves sewn over shame (3:7), this leaf of good news, and Lev 26:36's DRIVEN leaf whose sound chases the exiled — shame, hope, terror: one word, three lives [letter fact]. ZAYIT ('olive') — FIRST TOKEN of 10 (career: the lamp oil, Exod 27:20 / Lev 24:2; the anointing oil; the land's own trees, D…

VA-YEDA — 'and Noach KNEW that the waters had ABATED': knowledge from a carried sign — the inquiry closes in the knowing-verb, not in speech. QALU — the abate-root's token 2 (its token 3 is 8:21's never-again-CURSE: one root, abate and curse, all early tokens in the flood's resolution [letter fact, named-only]).

ONE VERB, TWO OPPOSITE READINGS, BOTH CARRIED [claim G19-14]. טָרָף (taraf) is read as KILLED - the leaf torn off, in the vocabulary later used of Joseph - and as SUSTENANCE, in the dove's own recorded prayer: 'may my sustenance be bitter as the olive and dependent on YOUR hands rather than sweet as honey and dependent on flesh and blood'. The dove is read typologically besides: had it found rest …

VA-YIYACHEL — 'and he WAITED': the SECOND wait in a SECOND verb — the yachal-root ('wait/hope'), a TORAH HAPAX lemma (this token and no other): the letter spends a once-word on the second patience [letter fact; Onkelos levels both waits to one verb — dual-track, flagged].
The THIRD sending (piel) — SHALACH token 7: the last of the span's five send-tokens; the next send in the corpus's story is no longer a scout's.

'And she did not RETURN to him ANY MORE' (perfect, held as fact): the good news this time is an absence — and the accents end the verse on the lone word OD ('any more'): the last thing the letter says about the dove is the word for AGAIN, negated [tree fact].

THE CORPUS'S SECOND FULL CALENDAR DATE — year 601, month 1, day 1: new year's day of the year after the flood — and the TIME register anchors here (decision: the date ladder's ONLY year-bearing rung, formatted like gen_17's t0; the machine holds one t0 — the other rungs are held as facts). RISHON ('first') — FIRST TOKEN of 55, debuting INSIDE the date (career: 'this month is for you the FIRST of m…

CHARVU — 'the waters were PARCHED/dried' (perfect, held as fact): CHAREV — BOTH its Torah tokens sit inside this single verse (the waters here; the ground's face below): a two-token verb spent in one breath [letter fact].

VA-YASAR — 'and Noach REMOVED the COVERING of the ark': SUR ('remove/turn aside') FIRST TOKEN of 55; MIKHSEH ('covering') FIRST TOKEN of 16 — and tokens 2-16 are ALL sanctuary fabric: the Tabernacle's covering (Exod 26-40) and the packed coverings of the march (Num 3-4): the ark's lid is the word's only non-sanctuary token — the first roof taken off in the corpus [letter fact].

VA-YAR VE-HINNEH — 'and he SAW, and BEHOLD': the week's inspection verb hands a man the whole horizon — and the letter withholds the verdict-word (no tov, no adjective at all): seeing without judging; TESTS stay empty [decision recorded].
The seen state, held: the face of the ground — the adamah whose face the wipe cleared (7:23) — dried before his eyes (perfect, fact).

LIVE CALENDAR LAW STANDS ON THIS DATE OPERATOR [claim G19-13]. R. Meir derives the rule that ONE DAY IN A YEAR COUNTS AS A YEAR from this verse's own ink: one day into the six hundred and first year, and the verse already calls it a year. Month 2, day 27 — TEN DAYS past the entry-date's slot one year on (7:11's month-2-day-17) [letter arithmetic; the solar/lunar-year doctrine built on the gap is the chain's — named-only].
